_Requested by **litlfred** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9?thread=cmsg_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9P2GGAjGMvE2u8HqJwVqJE8)_

Change set for #84 (4th set split from #76 / #64, owner decision Q-SPLIT-1 A).

**Committee content change: do not merge.** This stays a draft until the Authoring Committee decides.

## What it carries

The glossary part of #64, file for file unchanged, rebased onto current main:
- `glossary/dth-hrh.glossary.json`: 39 new `candidate` abbreviation terms, plus notations and altLabels on 10 workbook terms
- `glossary/twg-professional-council-examples.glossary.json`: acronym altLabels
- `scripts/glossary/build_glossary.py`: keeps these across `glossary:build`

The generated glossary chapter blocks (`folio/dth-hrh/glossary/g-*`) are not regenerated here, as in #64. If CI asks for them, I'll regenerate them in this PR.

## Checks

Not run locally (the platform mounts could not be set up in this session); CI runs them.
